comments.body_html:
The installed free camera mods are terkoiz freecam, hollywood cam, and cinematic unity explorer, but they are all disabled when you use your mod After activating the free camera I have two problems with the settings:

  1. If the “Control player from freecam” setting is activated, the camera is fixed, the character is visible and can be controlled, but the size of the character’s hands changes slightly (they become larger due to a collision error)
  2. When the “player follows freecam” setting is activated, the character is not visible at all, but the camera can still be controlled

comments.author: Hysocs
comments.body_html:
Yes, this is intended behavior. Player Follows Freecam is a special mode that lets you use the freecam to move around the map while your character follows its position. You cannot see the character because the camera is positioned inside the player model.

I may rename it, since Player Follows Freecam could sound like the character automatically follows the camera while remaining on the ground. Noclip is probably a clearer name because that is closer to how the mode works.

There is usually no reason to leave it enabled unless you want to fly around while still being your character. In most cases, you would briefly enable it and then disable it again to teleport your character to the freecam’s current position.
